_comment: UK DESNZ/Defra GHG conversion factors 2025 — modal_default freight rows.
Primary source: 'Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2025' (DESNZ), published 2025-06-10.
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/greenhouse-gas-reporting-conversion-factors-2025
'full set (for advanced users)' xlsx, category 'Freighting goods'.
PROVENANCE FLAG (label per CLAUDE.md rule 14 — read this before --apply):
[UNCONFIRMED] against the primary spreadsheet in the authoring session. The primary xlsx could
not be fetched (assets.publishing.service.gov.uk returned HTTP 403 from the sandboxed egress
proxy — org policy denial, not retried per proxy README) and WebFetch cannot parse an .xlsx
binary. The co2e_factor (kg CO2e / tonne.km) values below were read from a third-party
republication that itself cites DEFRA 2025 as its source:
https://github.com/starrybodies/ghg-calculator
src/ghg_calculator/factors/data/defra/v2025.json (fetched via raw.githubusercontent.com)
The category names and structure (Rigid HGV by weight band, Articulated HGV, HGV average,
Rail freight) match the real DESNZ 'Freighting goods' table layout, and only the single
aggregate co2e_factor column is used here — the same repo's per-gas CH4/N2O split was NOT used
(cross-checking two rows found ch4_factor == n2o_factor identically, which does not hold in any
DEFRA table read this session and looks like a synthetic placeholder split, not a transcription
of DEFRA's actual per-gas columns — so co2_fossil/ch4/n2o are left null here rather than carry
that risk forward).
ACTION BEFORE --apply: verify each ttw_co2e value against the DESNZ full-set xlsx, tab
'Freighting goods', before this fixture seeds production. Do not trust this fixture's precision
past 3 significant figures — that is what the third-party source itself carried.
as_at_date / valid_from: 2025-06-10, the DESNZ publication date for the 2025 factor set.
gwp_basis: 'unstated' — neither the third-party republication nor this session's access to the
primary source stated which IPCC AR the co2e_factor column was computed under; guessing one
would be worse than saying so (vocabularies.mjs GWP_BASIS note).
derivation: 'observed' — the ttw_co2e value is used as published by the primary source, not
recomputed by us (contrast the EPA fixture, which IS a derived/calculated conversion).
